homepage.heroDescription: In this study, you will interact with AI agents while working on a possible research question for a bachelor’s or master’s thesis.
homepage.cardDescription: Please interact with the AI agents as naturally as possible. There are no correct or incorrect responses. Your honest interaction is what matters most.

finish.title: ⚠️ Attention ⚠️
finish.message: Are you sure you want to finish this chat? You cannot continue after proceeding.
finish.redirectMessage: Before proceeding, please make sure you remember your final research question. In the next survey, you will be asked to enter your final research question before continuing. Once you proceed, you will not be able to return to this chat session.

thankYou.title: Thank You!
thankYou.message: Thank you for participating in our research study.

continueExperiment.title: Part 2 of the Experiment
continueExperiment.message: You have successfully completed the first part of the experiment. Next, you will interact with a second AI agent. Please continue the discussion naturally, just as you did in the first part.

experimentComplete.title: Finalizing the Experiment
experimentComplete.message: Thank you for completing the experiment. Your responses are being saved. You will be redirected to the final page shortly.
